control.EH: Original enter_handler/catch_bind/finally_enter and real completion route graph; EH-control differs from escaping mayThrow. Pure invoke projection scaffolding alone is not Source EH.
control.construction: receiver_bind/get/result have no direct result and exactly normal/language successors. Initialization rights are per successful bind, path and activation; language abrupt completion may abandon rights while preserving the binding, partial fields and prior effects. Request termination is not a language successor.
control.initialization: Complete Source-order module initializer bodies are independently verified and kept separate from kernel reachability.
control.invoke: Exactly normal and language-exception successors, independently checked actual signature and argument order.
control.invoke_method: Original static method and signature plus the complete independently reconstructed dispatch table. Receiver and all arguments evaluate once. Two normal/language successors; actual calls filter receiver tag and object identity per arm.
control.numeric_use: Exactly one normal native-i32 successor. Both original operands evaluate first, then numeric operand checks in Source order. Failure terminates request.
control.ordinary: Real standard cf.br/cf.cond_br and func.return; original source anchors retained.

environment.activation: One env_alloc entry prefix per factory activation; parent operand iff layout has parent. Actual activation plus callsite distinguishes instances; repeated recursive/loop sites remain weak summaries.
environment.carrier: env:<stable layout ID>; eight-byte managed reference; not a Source semantic type
environment.closure: make_closure has zero operands for null environment_layout, otherwise one exact lexical environment. Code and environment identity remain one saved pair; no type-wide environment permission.
environment.entry: Nested function lexicalEnvironment is a hidden first env argument. It never changes Source signature or Published parameter indices.
environment.slots: env_init/load/store properties layout, original raw binding, stable key; init/store env+value -> no result; load env -> slot carrier. env_parent child -> exact direct parent.

hosts.binding: Source ambient Host ID and structural signature remain separate from capability31 ABI signature. Complete VM/AOT BuildIdentity/BuildInputSet and reviewed implementation-bound HSC are independently verified by each cold consumer.
hosts.execution: Static validation only; no Host/native/VM/AOT execution authority.
hosts.operation: host_call evaluates ordered native scalar arguments once; verified Counter has a normal unknown-i32 result, both fixed resources are read-write even for argument0; no callback, borrow or retention grant.

identity.currentArtifact: Original raw fact IDs/ranges/runtimeKey, source bytes, input identity and HIR/representation hashes bind only the complete current artifact.
identity.functions: Existing tsfg.module-callable-function.candidate.v1 over source path, canonical qualified declaration path/kind/name, and stable signature.
identity.globals: Existing tsfg.global over module source path, declaration name or unique $default slot, and stable semantic type ID.
identity.published: Stable semantic declaration keys, labelled complete type-shape graph, signatures, module/import/export/root scope and fixed upper only. Never current body, Derived, source digest or raw range IDs.

indirectCall.order: Saved callee pair first, then all original arguments in order, once; exactly normal/language successors.
indirectCall.properties: signature_hash is the structural Source signature; targets={top,functions:[{function_id,signature_hash}]} is exact fixed-flow upper, not signature enumeration
indirectCall.publication: Complete fixed parameter/return/slot transfers are independently checked. Consume every allowed target fixed upper; body or site observations cannot narrow it.

initializers.range: [0, original module Source UTF16 length); no fabricated Source function/type

internalConstructors.bindings: Exact private parameter storage rows {id,carrier}, strictly sorted by id; id + /parameter/ + decimal ordinal; no receiver Cell.
internalConstructors.directory: Required representation.internalConstructors, strictly sorted by internal id; exact public-projected-invoke reachable helper closure; [] when empty.
internalConstructors.effects: Current-body internal constructor summaries compose in the existing finite Source effect domain; ordinary public calls consume the complete fixed upper, never their current body.
internalConstructors.fuel: No added implicit-constructor entry fuel; ordinary public and Source call/loop fuel retain semantics.
internalConstructors.id: analysis-construction: + original ConstructionId; never a Published FunctionId or a public function-table member.
internalConstructors.parameters: receiver:owner hidden control first, then the raw logical argument capacities by ordinal. Version3 follows implicit bases to the owning explicit constructor parameterInitialization argumentType list; otherwise the original declared construction parameters apply. No lexical environment. The helper fixed formal vector may contain normalized omitted undefined and is not claimed as the Source original argument list.
internalConstructors.result: Same solved selected result carrier, preserving actual U and normal Bottom.
internalConstructors.signature: sha256(tsfg.common-program.analysis-construction-signature.v1 + NUL + canonical({construction,parameters: helper.parameters.map(row => row.type),returnType: owner})), over the logical visible raw argument types. For version2 raw types equal declared types, so the original signature bytes are preserved.
internalConstructors.source: Independently pre-register all implicit owners/parameters, reconstruct SourcePlan and compare every supplied helper body/anchor/ABI. No public HIR/Scope mutation.
internalConstructors.status: Private Core4 draft only; no formal Runtime/wire/native admission.

kernel: Validate the complete Program for every request. targets=[] requests no kernel permission and has empty accesses/pairs. Nonempty requests have 2..32 declared kernel roots and complete fixed upper checks; all fixed Host resource access is rejected at its actual call origin.

fields: hir_hash:StringAttr SHA256 canonical HIR plus LF
representation_hash:StringAttr SHA256 canonical representation plus LF
publication:StringAttr canonical fixed Published JSON without LF
request:StringAttr canonical kernel request JSON without LF
proof:StringAttr canonical supplied proof JSON without LF
marker.name: tsfg_program.program

methodDispatch.abi: Join complete target ABI capacities without changing actual tags. Each arm passes only its receiver-filtered actual value and evaluated parameter prefix; unsupported missing parameters remain rejected.
methodDispatch.order: Strict receiver_type byte order; one exact effective target per eligible owned nominal actual type.
methodDispatch.publication: Consume every selected target fixed upper in body/effects, call graph, SCC and multiplicity. Never substitute the static member upper or a narrower current body.
methodDispatch.selection: Override chain first, else independently validated M12 source-member mapping followed by actual override selection. The table grants no actual tags. Constructors and explicit base calls remain single-target invoke.

operationAttributes: view_type:StringAttr semantic type ID or void

ownedHir.complete: One official Program and original raw Symbol/type/source directory. All functions, module initializers and ordinary code remain represented; no partial-package composition.

constructorParameters.argumentTypes: A parameter with its own initializer accepts declared type or actual undefined at entry; other raw parameters keep their declared type. Initialized bindings preserve actual values, including undefined returned by assertions or initializers; declarations never retag them.
constructorParameters.evaluation: Only actual undefined, including omitted arguments, selects the initializer. Evaluation is left to right, once, with earlier bindings and effects retained across language abrupt completion. Source new/super argument vectors retain their real length; normalized fixed helper formals are not an original Source argument vector.
constructorParameters.identity: Version3 constructor minimum arity and raw argument types are in its stable semantic shape. Initializer expressions and ranges are current body facts, outside stable declaration identity, and remain subject to complete current-body validation and fixed permissions.
constructorParameters.owner: Every explicit constructor function in private Source3/HIR3 owns one complete parameterInitialization record; Source2/HIR2 retains its original required-parameter contract.
constructorParameters.steps: Every declared parameter appears once in ordinal order, with its own binding, complete declaration range, raw argumentType and optional original initializer expression. Initializer bindings and annotation ranges are independently checked in the parameter scope; body declarations do not enter that scope.

physicalTypes.carrier: !tsfg_program.carrier<carrierKey>; independent exact type/domain layout, never a universal width.
physicalTypes.cell: !tsfg_program.cell<originalBindingId>; internal compiler storage, not a Source nominal.
physicalTypes.initialization: !tsfg_program.carrier<"initialization:" + ownerTypeId>; internal path-linear initialization cursor, never ordinary storage or a Source value.
physicalTypes.native: Existing exact native scalar MLIR types.
physicalTypes.receiver: !tsfg_program.carrier<"receiver:" + ownerTypeId>; internal constructor control frame, never an actual Source value or parameter-0 object.

publication.access: Exact GlobalId reads/writes and parameter-owner read/write/structural bounds; never derive a narrower permission from current implementation.
publication.captures: upper.captures=[{slot,read,write,structural}]; stable parent/layout/membership is scoped; current instances/ranges are not

hostResources.writes: Sorted fixed resources; complete callees/SCC/indirect upper consumption, never narrowed by body

publication.record: Exact ordered contracts contain functionId, signatureHash, full fixed upper, callables, returnOrigins and digest. The complete group digest binds every row including null; current body and every permitted target must satisfy the fixed contracts before kernel proof.

returnOrigins.body: Derive the current Source body graph independently and require it to be covered by the admitted fixed graph. Concrete Code or observed arms never remove a different permitted target upper.
returnOrigins.fixed: Owned immutable Graph5/protocol/upper for the complete permitted function group; normal and language channels stay distinct. Constructor frame inputs are separate from logical published receiver role0; complete fixed receiver grants apply to every bound receiver across both completion lifetimes.
returnOrigins.null: Unavailable fixed return/content protocol; never Bottom, empty graph or an implicit proof grant.
returnOrigins.unavailable: Only proof independent of unavailable return/content authority can proceed. A scalar exception requires separately verified complete Source views and full fixed-target closure, not a claimed upper alone.

publication.scope: Complete owned semantic declaration/type/module/global/import/export/Env directory, sorted construction protocol directory and fixed storage tables under common-program-fixed-v4, bound to the same scope and group. Function construction metadata binds ConstructionId, owner/base and public receiverIndex0. Current bodies and initialization source identities are excluded from declaration identity; fixed return Graph5 belongs to each contract, not the scope.

storage.admission: Metadata admission binds the full table to the same owned catalogue. It does not authorize copy/address callbacks.
storage.budget: Use the existing cumulative physical/Program work remaining; never create or reset a separate work allowance.
storage.currentProfile: Current private4 nominal scalar tuple copy capability is per actual type. Complete owning Source type/member identities, all selected compatibility/dependency and entry roots, field/container/callable/lexical-layout dependencies and inheritance/construction roles form a conservative dependency closure. Every owned function binding and body, field initializer, module initialization and construction parameter participates, including functions outside requested reachability. All nonnative owned value/view identities in an owning body are conservatively connected; shared scalar/absence leaves do not create object-alias edges. Unknown assertions or other payload-preserving views stay globally Open unless the entire chain is native-only: primitive literal or native binding leaves, with catch provenance admitted only for a complete protected region consisting of one pure native throw and no writes to that catch binding. Calls, fields, unbounded unknown bindings and observed exception samples cannot supply that proof. Only bodies isolated from structural, subclass and explicit-construction components can close. Unresolved identity/dependency or a possible constructor value replacement is not narrowed from observed arms; all possibly affected types stay Open. Foreign storage remains globally unavailable.
storage.proof: For each isolated body independently cross-check own property identities, scalar initialization, actual field carriers, its complete tuple layout and every relevant conditional ancestor-constructor/newTarget role against the same complete fixed table. Unrelated unresolved components do not erase that proof. Recompute the current Source dependency closure even though bodies are excluded from stable declaration identity. Fixed TOP cannot upgrade from narrower current carriers/results; actual capacity exceeding a known fixed upper is rejected. An unresolved body retains reference identity where applicable but supplies no physical field route or Value copy. Do not substitute Source field declarations or future storage-v2 state/tag plans.
storage.record: Complete fields[{fieldId,actualTypes,unknown}] and results[{construction,newTarget,actualTypes,unknown}], including every ancestor-constructor/newTarget pair. Both arrays may be empty only when complete role ownership or the unchanged global foreign-storage exclusion is unavailable. Otherwise every role remains present, including unresolved components. unknown:true requires actualTypes:[] and means unresolved TOP, never Bottom or a sampled finite bound.

receiverProtocol.allocation: receiver_create/child create only control identities. Only a base receiver_allocate allocates the dynamic newTarget instance. Bind occurs after complete base Construct; duplicate binding language-fails without replacing the previous bound value.
receiverProtocol.entry: An explicit constructor has one hidden receiver:owner physical parameter after any lexical environment. It does not seed a this object or Cell. receiver_get/bind/result supply selected payload facts.
receiverProtocol.initialization: initialize_begin consumes the successful binding right; initialize_field consumes the exact current cursor and next own initialization FieldId in the independently derived phase order: ordinary instance fields in Source order, then parameter properties in parameter order. For a base constructor, ordinary fields precede parameter FDI/defaults and parameter properties follow it; for a derived constructor, defaults precede the body/super call and own fields/properties follow successful super. The cursor remains linear across parameter initialization control flow. initialize_end consumes the complete cursor. Normal completion cannot skip unfinished rights; language abrupt completion preserves earlier writes, initialized bindings and escape.
receiverProtocol.owner: Complete semantic TypeId joined to the existing construction owner; new_target is the dynamic original newTarget and never retags a replacement object.
receiverProtocol.results: receiver_result selects the already evaluated explicit object return or applies base/derived undefined/primitive rules after body/finally completion. No frame, owner view or TypeId changes actual object identity/tag/layout.
receiverProtocol.status: draft exact private4 protocol, not formal wire adoption
receiverProtocol.wire: The draft control sizes and receiver:owner/initialization:owner names do not authorize existing wire17. New carrier/ABI/index/cold-reader/Runtime mapping and authoritative Core/wire versions remain separate unadopted dependencies.

representation.actual: Reached actual tags/values remain distinct from conditional storage/ABI capacity. Assertion, alias, storage, call and return preserve actual tags. Only approved same-i32/undefined numeric consumption has a request-trap edge; no language handler or finally edge.
representation.bindings: Complete original BindingId -> physical carrier capacity, including module/catch/local/receiver cells; original Source fieldId selects the shared conditional field capacity; element:<owned Array SemanticTypeId> selects the shared conditional Array element capacity. Actual object/array instances and normal values remain separate.
representation.domains: Existing tsfg.actual-domain.v1 identity over sorted actual semantic TypeIDs; exact layout/tag/root-count independently recomputed.
representation.functions: Stable owned FunctionId -> ordered parameter carrier capacities and result carrier. Explicit constructors replace the ordinary receiver physical parameter with receiver:owner after any lexical environment; logical Published owner indices do not change. Methods retain ordinary receiver values.

returnOriginConstruction.budget: All scans, copies, lookup, state growth, joins and archive operations use existing cumulative work and current module rates; no reset or independent cap.
returnOriginConstruction.callReceiver: Call.receiver is null or a nonempty frame-reference set, never logical receiver0 data. Constructor data argument vectors exclude logical receiver0: parameter nodes retain public logical indices1..N and index i reads Call.arguments[i-1]; constructor parameter0 nodes are forbidden. Ordinary calls use null and retain ordinary indexing. Complete public receiver0 grants apply to actual data bound by the called constructor own receiver input/child frames throughout both normal and language lifetime, not to empty values, unrelated nested new frames or only the final returned object.
returnOriginConstruction.category: Object/undefined/Other is separate from owner provenance. Function and nominal value payloads are Object; managed String is primitive Other. Views/assertions/copies preserve category. Unproved formal, field and capture categories remain all three. Generated undefined and synthetic language payloads use type:null rather than inventing a Source TypeId.

constructionRows.functionId: null for private implicit helpers, otherwise owned explicit FunctionId; helpers never become Published functions or group members
constructionRows.order: strict ConstructionId byte order, complete catalogue

returnOriginConstruction.fixedAuthority: Consume complete immutable permitted target graphs and every fixed upper; no observed-arm pruning, body-derived grant replacement, metadata refresh or source-anchor authority.
returnOriginConstruction.frame: Only activation identity, construction owner, original dynamic newTarget and unbound/bound receiver data are retained. A child inherits newTarget from its parent; newTarget is null exactly when inherited from a non-null parent. Fixed catalogue joins validate owner/base/newTarget roles.
returnOriginConstruction.frameExclusion: Frame reference closure is separate from data reference closure, including joins and gates. Frames cannot enter fields, Env, code payloads, Host arguments, ordinary data arguments or user normal/language results.
returnOriginConstruction.functionConstruction: null or {id:ConstructionId,owner:TypeId,base:TypeId|null,receiverIndex:0}; published parameterTypes keep logical receiver0

generatedLanguageObject.category: Object, independently of missing Source type or declared view
generatedLanguageObject.identity: A generated data object identity owned by the receiverAction language outcome, distinct from frame identity and primitive literals; no invented Source TypeId.
generatedLanguageObject.origin: Only receiverAction get/bind/result protocol failures synthesize ReferenceError or TypeError payloads; original Source throw and call language results retain their own data and categories.
generatedLanguageObject.selection: A caught protocol error explicitly returned from a derived constructor is an Object replacement result. It must not be classified as primitive Other.

returnOriginConstruction.initialization: Project qualified initialize_field operations as ordinary owner heap stores. Preserve original normal/language edges, partial heaps and preceding writes on abrupt completion; no source range, generated flag or current body grants fresh/init authority.
returnOriginConstruction.producer: Project admitted normalized constructor CFG through one construction-transfer interface. Reuse established CFG initialization ordering and linear-right qualification; do not add an independent AST constructor or initializer cursor interpreter.
returnOriginConstruction.selection: Use actual category to apply existing base/derived receiver-result rules. Explicit object replacement preserves its identity/tag/layout; base undefined/primitive selects bound receiver, derived undefined selects bound receiver and Other follows existing language failure semantics. Unbound/duplicate binding failures use language edges. Request termination is never a language edge. Synthetic receiver-action language errors have Object category and their own data identity even with type:null; Source and call language payload categories are not overwritten.
returnOriginConstruction.status: private graph candidate5; no formal wire17 or Runtime adoption

sourceScope: Private Source facts v2 and v3 retain one complete official Program and named function/capture/indirect facts; no arrow, bound-method value, block/loop capture or Host permission. Constructor parameter initialization is an explicit v3 extension with original expressions, bindings and ranges; original v2 packets are neither restamped nor silently extended.
